body:
Hi @Xaptor that's a very good usecase.

Right now there's no easy way to do this, we do not have query interpretation at Algolia level in the API. So we would have to find ways to do it on the frontend and update the filters accordingly.

We are currently focused on releasing a first working version of react-instantsearch, once we get that out we will be able to think about advanced use cases like yours.

Please allow us two weeks before we can come up with another response. Thanks
